messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release/2026.03.22-rc2 (d9a1b) -> prod/us-west-2. Canary rollout started (staggered: 5% -> 15% -> 25%). Running post-deploy synthetic suite and healthchecks.

Elena: Noting an increase in p99 for /v1/generate in us-west-2 on the synth probes: baseline ~680ms, current p99 ~1.6s. No global error surge but tail looks bad. Sample traces attached to the dashboard. cc @Ravi @Tomas

Ravi: Thanks. What about short prompt vs long prompt split? Could be seq_len causing KV cache churn.

Maya: The synthetic mix is 50/50 short/long. The spikes are correlated with requests that hit >1024 tokens.

Tomas: I'm seeing increased CPU steal on the inference-proxy hosts for the canary pool around the same times. Possibly batching regression in the new runtime.

Elena: Do we pin the route to the previous runtime or reduce canary percent?

Ravi: Suggest immediate hold at current percent (15%). Apply route pin for generate service in us-west-2 to modelvariant `serve-v2-a` (last-known-good). Also enable aggressive prefix caching so repeated prefixes don't rehydrate.

Tomas: Can someone run the pin command? I don't have console access atm.

Maya: I can do it. Running: 
```
rbctl pin-route --region=us-west-2 --service=generate --to=model:serve-v2-a --duration=60m --reason="postdeploy p99 tail"
```

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin initiated by Maya at 1776543225. Duration=60m. Monitoring config updated.

Elena: After pin, reran 2k synth requests: p99 reduced to ~720ms (closer to baseline). No 5xx observed in this quick run.

Ravi: Good. Keep rollout paused and extend canary watch to 45m. Also add temporary throttle on long-seq batching: max_batch_tokens=4096 on canary pool. This reduces batch mixing of long/short requests.

Tomas: Patch applied to canary pool config: `max_batch_tokens=4096` at 1776543240. Observability: https://internal.redwood/obs/canary/1776543210

Maya: Updating release notes: "Canary paused at 15% in us-west-2 due to p99 tail increase on /v1/generate for long sequences. Route pinned to serve-v2-a; batching limits applied. Watch 45m."

Elena: Also documenting escalation path: if p99 > 1s for 10m -> full revert to release/2026.03.20 and pager on-call.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 15% per operator action. To continue: `deploy resume --percent=25`. To revert: `deploy revert --to=release/2026.03.20`.

Ravi: I'll dig into the runtime change that affects batching semantics (kernel scheduling diff). Tomas, can you collect host-level perf counters and queue depths for the pinned vs canary pools?

Tomas: Collecting now, will post results in 20m.

Maya: Standby. If anyone wants to run local repros against the pinned route, use `rbctl route-proxy --region=us-west-2 --service=generate --variant=serve-v2-a`.

Elena: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after 45m or earlier if alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
